title: Convert material digital table into renderable record
goal: Traverse the object's own keys and values ​​simultaneously through Object.entries.
summary: summary interface returns the corresponding table from the material name to the existing quantity. The list component needs to obtain a set of records in a given order.
tasks: completes inventoryRows(inventory), and each positive inventory generates a { name, quantity } object.
preserves the order in which Object.entries are returned. Materials with a quantity of 0 are not added to the results.

example.note: entries turns each attribute into a pair [name, quantity], which can be read using array destructuring.

hint: first filters the key-value pairs whose quantity is zero, and then converts the remaining [name, quantity] into objects.
